files_reviewed: App.jsx (root, stale copy not in the Vite build, grep plus partial)
note: No database schema or migrations are committed, so the database_rules labels are inferred from code and from CLAUDE.md line 42, which says there is no RLS. No ai_browser_call found. All model calls run in the Python backend. No real secret values are committed. .env.example holds placeholders only. The root App.jsx is an older copy that the Vite app does not import. Cancel booking checks ownership and admin stats checks is_admin on the server, so those are fine.

labels.what: book_slot writes an appointment and locks the slot straight from the model call. The system prompt tells the model to pick and book without asking the user, so no person approves the booking
emergency_book books a priority slot that jumps the queue with no staff or patient approval. The emergency prompt also says do not ask questions, act now

book_slot has no cap on bookings per user or per turn, so one chat can book many slots in 8 tool rounds. patient_name and patient_id come from the model with no check against the logged-in user. The slots JSON is read, changed and written back with no lock, and the slot is marked taken before the insert, so a failed insert leaves a slot locked with no appointment
emergency_book does not check that emergency mode is active or that the request is real. Any call books the next slot flagged is_emergency, with no limit per user

book_slot description says only call after the user has confirmed the option. No confirmation flag or check exists in book_slot. prompts.py lines 38-40 tell the model the opposite, so the rule is both unenforced and contradicted

Prompt says use emergency_book only if the situation sounds like a medical emergency (tool description repeats it at tools.py 104-108). emergency_book code never checks should_trigger_emergency or any flag
Prompt says do not book without the patient name. book_slot accepts any string, including an empty one, and never compares it with the logged-in user
Prompt says never use a doctor_id that did not appear in an earlier tool result. No code tracks which ids were returned, so book_slot accepts any doctor_id that has a schedule row

The only instruction to tell a patient to call emergency services or go to the ER is in the prompt. The /emergency and /book handlers return the model reply as is, with no fixed safety message added in code
send_notification tool only prints to the server log and returns success with a timestamp. Nothing is sent to the patient
resolve_location is a hardcoded table of 12 city coordinates in place of geocoding. Mumbai, Pune, Delhi and Kolkata are seeded with hospitals but missing here, so distance search fails for them
Mock run_agent returns canned tool steps and a canned booking for Dr. Ananya Sharma at Sunrise Skin Clinic on 2026-07-07. It runs when USE_MOCK_AGENT is true or when the provider import fails
Hardcoded fake doctors, ratings, distances, slots and a fixed appointment date inside the mock agent

Real hospital brand names (Apollo, Manipal, Fortis and others) paired with generated doctor names, random ratings and random experience. The agent ranks and books against these as if they were real doctors
Queue length and average wait time are random numbers seeded once and never updated. The agent and UI present them as the live queue and pick doctors by them
Landing page demo animation with hardcoded steps, doctor name and Email delivered to patient. It is a marketing demo, not wired to the backend

Appointment card shows Confirmation email sent when the send_notification step completes. That tool only prints a log line, and the default live-stream path never sends the email, so the user sees a confirmation that did not happen

The streaming endpoint, which the UI uses by default (liveMode true), books the slot but never calls _send_confirmation_email or mark_emergency_booking. Only POST /book does. README says every booking sends a real email
Timeline label says Confirmation sent and detail says delivered for the send_notification stub, which sends nothing
mark_emergency_booking says production would notify on-call staff. It only appends to an in-memory list and prints, so no one is alerted and the audit log is lost on restart
If the provider import fails, the server falls back to the mock agent with only a startup print. The UI then shows an Appointment confirmed card for a booking that was never written
POST /book needs no login. The token is optional and the login redirect exists only in client code, so anyone can run the paid agent and book real slots
POST /api/chat/stream needs no login. Anonymous callers can run the agent and book
POST /emergency needs no login. Anyone can create priority bookings that jump the queue and trigger emails
/memory/save and /memory/{patient_name} need no login. Anyone can read or overwrite any patient's preferences, notes and booking history by name
GET /emergency/log needs no login and returns doctor, hospital, time and the medical reason for every emergency booking
WebSocket /ws/{session_id} needs no login and runs the agent, books, and sends email
Session id comes from the client (sess_ plus a timestamp in the UI) with no owner check. Anyone who knows or guesses it can read and continue another user's conversation
find_patient_by_name returns the first patient whose name partly matches, with no owner check. A % in the name matches anyone
Stale root copy of the UI with a cosmetic sign-in. Any name and email log in and the password is never checked. Not used by the Vite build

Admin live feed subscribes to appointments with the public anon key. Auth is a custom JWT, so the browser has no Supabase session, and this only works if the anon role can read appointments. With no RLS (CLAUDE.md 42), the same public key lets any visitor query users (password_hash, is_admin), appointments and schedules through PostgREST, and possibly write is_admin. main.jsx bundles Admin for every visitor
Every query, including user-facing ones, uses the service role key. CLAUDE.md says there is no RLS, so each ownership rule lives only in Python filters
Supabase anon key read from VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY into the browser bundle. Public by design, risky only with the missing RLS above
Hardcoded JWT signing secret used when JWT_SECRET is unset, secret value present. All tokens are forgeable if the env var is missed, and the app only prints a warning
Patient name and free-text notes from the unauthenticated /memory/save endpoint are pasted into the system prompt with no guard. Anyone can plant instructions for a named patient's future sessions
No rate limit on any paid model endpoint (/book, /api/chat/stream, /emergency, /ws). CLAUDE.md 42 confirms there is no rate limiting
Confirmation email goes to whatever patient_email the request sends, with no verification and no login. Anyone can make the server email any address
Emergency mode turns on by keyword match, including bare urgent and emergency. Any user can type urgent to get queue-jumping priority bookings
30-day JWT stored in localStorage, readable by any script on the page
SESSIONS and patient memory are process dicts with no expiry or size cap. Memory grows with each new session id and all data is lost on restart
Login has no attempt limit or lockout, so passwords can be brute forced
CORS allows credentials from any localhost port in production, with all methods and headers
API_URL falls back to http://localhost:8000
API_URL falls back to http://localhost:8000
API_URL falls back to http://localhost:8000
Stale root copy with API_URL falling back to http://localhost:8000
Schedules are seeded only for fixed dates 2026-07-12 to 2026-07-19. Slot search looks from today forward, so nothing is bookable after those dates
find_doctors caps rows at 25 before the distance filter, so near doctors can be cut off. Slot lookahead is 4 days at line 107 and 7 days at line 201, two values for the same kind of window
UI specialty list says it matches the seed data but uses General Physician (seed has General Medicine) and leaves out Psychiatry
Model id and MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS = 8 hardcoded, and the 8 is copied in two other providers and in the UI MAX_STEPS
Server port 8000 in app.py and 8080 in Procfile, two values for the same setting
JWT expiry fixed at 30 days in code
